Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Could you give me any idea what is the[ value of my copy rights](../others.html#160), I do not mean that I want to part with them, but it would be convenient to me to know what is likely to be the full value of my property, and what I could raise by them in case of need[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Endorsed \'See my letter.

Feb 29/1\'.

[^2]: This question is likely to have been prompted by anxiety about the financial situation of CMY\'s brother [Julian](../persons.html#1624).
